mapper.sql: L.LEDGER_NO, L.MBR_ID, L.PNT_TYPE, L.PNT_AMT, L.REMAIN_AMT, L.ORD_NO, L.ORG_LEDGER_NO, L.EXP_DT, TO_CHAR(L.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REG_DT, L.REG_ID, L.RMK
AND L.PNT_TYPE IN ('EARN', 'ADJ', 'USE_CNCL') AND L.PNT_AMT > 0 AND L.REMAIN_AMT > 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_PNT_LEDGER L WHERE L.ORD_NO = #{ordNo} AND L.PNT_TYPE = 'USE' AND L.REMAIN_AMT > 0 ORDER BY L.LEDGER_NO DESC
SELECT FROM TB_PNT_LEDGER L WHERE L.ORD_NO = #{ordNo} AND L.PNT_TYPE = 'EARN' ORDER BY L.LEDGER_NO
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM TB_PNT_LEDGER WHERE ORD_NO = #{ordNo} AND PNT_TYPE = 'EARN'

SELECT FROM TB_PNT_LEDGER L WHERE L.EXP_DT < #{baseDt}
ORDER BY L.MBR_ID, L.EXP_DT, L.LEDGER_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PNT_LEDGER ( LEDGER_NO, MBR_ID, PNT_TYPE, PNT_AMT, REMAIN_AMT, ORD_NO, ORG_LEDGER_NO, EXP_DT, REG_DT, REG_ID, RMK) VALUES ( #{LEDGER_NO}, #{MBR_ID}, #{PNT_TYPE}, #{PNT_AMT}, NVL(#{REMAIN_AMT}, 0), #{ORD_NO}, #{ORG_LEDGER_NO}, #{EXP_DT}, SYSDATE, #{REG_ID}, #{RMK})
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_PNT_BAL T USING (SELECT #{MBR_ID} AS MBR_ID FROM DUAL) S ON (T.MBR_ID = S.MBR_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET BAL_AMT = BAL_AMT + #{CHG_AMT}, UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (MBR_ID, BAL_AMT, UPD_DT) VALUES (#{MBR_ID}, #{CHG_AMT}, SYSDATE)
